title: HomeFlood Autopay Credit on Renewal
content:
**Rule.** A HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies renewal term premium carries an autopay credit, judged on the premium payments received for the expiring term.

| Premium payments received for the expiring term | Autopay credit |
|---|---|
| every one made by ACH, and at least 4 of them | 2 percent |
| one to three of them, every one made by ACH | 1 percent |
| no payment for the expiring term, or any of them made another way (check, card or escrow disbursement) | none |

**Form of the credit.** The credit is a percent of the premium the renewal term premium starts from, and it is subtracted from that premium.

**Which payments count.** The payments looked at are those recorded against the expiring term. A payment already received for the coming term, such as its first payment, belongs to the coming term and is not counted.

*Hypothetical cases:*
- Four QUARTERLY payments, all by ACH: 2 percent.
- Two semi-annual payments, both by ACH: 1 percent.
- Three ACH payments and one by check: none.
